---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an evidence-bound improvement
title: "feature: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What user, research, or safety problem would this solve?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful version. Include affected languages, rules, APIs, UI, or validation gates.

## Evidence and safety

What would demonstrate that the feature works? How will it preserve explicit approval, validation records, and honest reporting of skipped or unavailable checks?

## Alternatives

What simpler, safer, or existing approaches did you consider?
